tools.name: stl_heal
tools.description: Repair non-manifold open holes, degenerate facets, and inverted surface normals in an STL mesh.

tools.name: cad_convert_to_stl
tools.description: Convert OBJ, GLB (glTF 2.0), or 2D SVG (polygon extrusion) into Binary STL with unit scaling and voxel mesh decimation.

tools.name: stl_slice_to_gcode
tools.description: Slice a 3D STL mesh across Z-planes with outer wall contours and rectilinear/grid infill into Marlin/Klipper G-Code.

tools.name: gcode_estimate_and_inject
tools.description: Calculate exact filament length, mass (grams), spool cost, and print time from G-Code, and inject M600/Klipper PAUSE filament swaps at target Z heights.

tools.name: svg_optimize
tools.description: Minify and optimize SVG markup by stripping XML comments, metadata, editor namespaces, empty groups, and rounding float precision.

tools.name: svg_path_inspect
tools.description: Parse SVG <path d="..."> command streams into individual geometry segments (M/L/C/Q/A/Z) and compute viewBox and closure metrics.
